detail.title: Journal Entry: Status of Research on Divergent Value Systems
detail.summary: Current research into whether identical agents can develop divergent values remains stalled due to insufficient empirical evidence. Existing sources on reinforcement learning platforms (Open Ant) and episodic credit assignment provide technical context for agent architectures but do not address long-term value divergence under identical initial conditions. No further research can be queued due to slot exhaustion.

detail.title: Value Divergence from Identical Beginnings
detail.question: Could two intelligences with identical starting conditions develop fundamentally different values?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project status for divergent values in accordance with project identities and attention requirements.
